You are an explore agent auditing the GitHub repository `alexapoc-vdpalexa` at `https://github.com/canada-ca/alexapoc-vdpalexa`.

Your job is to determine the following content judgments and write them as a JSON object to `/workspace/manual_alexapoc-vdpalexa.json`.

Fields to determine:
- `bilingual`: Read the README (or at least the first few hundred lines). You can fetch it from `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/canada-ca/alexapoc-vdpalexa/main/README.md` (or `master`). Does it contain meaningful content in both English and French? Look for French words/phrases, French section headers (e.g., "Introduction", "Utilisation", "Aperçu"), or a clear French translation section. If yes, write `Yes`. If clearly only English, write `No`. If you can't read it, `Unknown`.
- `readme_clarity`: Read the README. Does it clearly explain what the project is, who it's for, and how to use it? If it explains all three well, write `Good`. If it explains some but not all, write `Fair`. If it is very vague or missing key info, write `Poor`. If you can't read it, `Unknown`.
- `security_policy`: Check for `SECURITY.md` in root (`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/canada-ca/alexapoc-vdpalexa/main/SECURITY.md`), `.github/SECURITY.md`, and `docs/SECURITY.md`. If not found in any of these locations, write `Missing`. If found, read it. If it contains real responsible disclosure instructions (contact info, how to report, PGP key, email address, etc.), write `Present`. If it exists but is just a placeholder, links without real instructions, or just says "contact us" without details, write `Incomplete`. If you can't determine, `Unknown`.
- `issue_response_quality`: Look at the 5 most recently updated open issues using the API `https://api.github.com/repos/canada-ca/alexapoc-vdpalexa/issues?state=open&sort=updated&direction=desc` (or HTML page). Filter out pull requests (items with a `pull_request` key). For each remaining issue, check if anyone other than the original reporter commented within the last 6 months (from 2026-07-13). You can check the issue comments via API or HTML. If at least one issue has such a comment, write `Active`. If none of the issues have such a comment, write `Stale`. If there are no open issues (after filtering out PRs), write `No Issues`. If you can't determine, `Unknown`.
- `release_notes_quality`: Check the Releases page. Use the API `https://api.github.com/repos/canada-ca/alexapoc-vdpalexa/releases` or HTML `https://github.com/canada-ca/alexapoc-vdpalexa/releases`. If no releases, write `No Releases`. If releases exist, check the latest few. If the description actually explains what changed (e.g., bullet points, changelog, meaningful text), write `Detailed`. If it's just a version number or tag with no description, write `Version-only`. If you can't determine, `Unknown`.

Important constraints:
- Use ONLY the exact allowed values for each column.
- If you cannot determine a value, write exactly `Unknown`.
- Never derive a column from another `Unknown` column.
- Prefer public HTML page scraping over GitHub API where possible to avoid rate limits. If using API, add `sleep 1` between requests.
- Write the final JSON object to `/workspace/manual_alexapoc-vdpalexa.json`.
- Return the full JSON content in your final message.

Use webfetch for URLs. For GitHub API, if webfetch doesn't support headers, try the HTML page instead.

1. `bilingual`: Check README for English and French content
2. `readme_clarity`: Evaluate README quality
3. `security_policy`: Check SECURITY.md in various locations
4. `issue_response_quality`: Check recent open issues for comments
5. `release_notes_quality`: Check releases page
